record_title: Near-maximum connected mutual visibility and sharp co-connected Nordhaus--Gaddum bounds
limitations: The result characterizes the near-maximum level n-1 and gives sharp co-connected Nordhaus--Gaddum bounds, but it does not characterize the n-2 level or all equality cases. Originality is to the best of our knowledge; the parameter and primary source are very recent, so unindexed parallel work remains a residual risk. No independent validation is asserted.
